history.summary: A 1,335sqft 4BR at PARKTOWN Residence, Tampines North's integrated mega-development (1,193 units, bus interchange/hawker/CC, direct CRL access), at $2.525M / $1,891 PSF — well below the $2,308 project median. The integrated-development + CRL catalyst is among the strongest in the batch, though it is an unbuilt 2028/2030-TOP new launch at investment-thin yield.
history.rating_rationale: Web check confirms this is a true integrated development (UOL/CapitaLand/SingLand) with a co-located bus interchange, hawker centre, community club and direct access to the upcoming Tampines North CRL station — a durable, scarce advantage that supports both rental and resale. The $1,891 PSF asking is a meaningful discount to the $2,308 project median (and below the ~$2,360 launch benchmark), an efficient 1,335sqft 4BR at $2.525M is at the band ceiling but justified by the format/location, and the huge 1,193-unit project plus 1,164-transaction depth means strong liquidity. Caveats: 99LH, new-launch bias on any rate, and 2030 TOP push the effective hold horizon out. The integrated/CRL catalyst and below-median entry tip this to Buy.
red_flags: Unbuilt new launch — no resale history, new-launch bias flagged; ~2030 TOP pushes out the hold horizon

history.summary: Scarce true integrated development (UOL/CapitaLand/SingLand) with bus interchange, hawker centre and direct CRL Tampines North access — a durable resale advantage — but the new-launch 4BR is fully priced at $2.5M.
history.rating_rationale: Integrated transit-connected developments hold value well, but the entry already capitalises that; no below-comps margin and a $2.5M 4BR quantum thins the pool. CRL is a real catalyst but multi-year out. Quality hold, not a forward edge → Neutral.
catalysts: integrated dev: bus interchange + hawker + CC
